step_by_step_reasoning: The visual architecture shows sensitive data discovery and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) across AWS accounts. Amazon Macie scans S3 buckets for sensitive data and sends findings/metadata to a central S3 findings bucket in a management account. Amazon Athena queries this finding data directly from S3. AWS Glue automates data aggregation and loading into a MySQL database data lake. Amazon QuickSight connects to Athena/S3 to visualize risk metrics, which are then analyzed by Security Engineers to coordinate remediation with bucket owners.
